R1.description: A push to main that changes only documentation skips the plan and the shards, with every doubt running them, and the managed conformance job still runs

R2.description: A Draft pull request runs the shards from the first implementation-review head and a ready one always does, so the acceptance gate's ci_green at the anchor commit and the Controller's green-checks condition at A are met by real runs

R3.description: The mutation check runs as three legs that together cover the module exactly once, fail closed, keep the job id and the release gate, and stay within six runners

R4.description: The shard timings are refreshed on a schedule from pull-request runs, deduplicated and checked against the staleness ratchet, and proposed as a pull request

R5.description: The pages and item records state the policy, the estimates, the unproven point and the follow-up, and the determinism split is its own backlog item
